data.action: 海滨贩卖机前比较冷饮性价比，坐到海堤边贴脸降温并偷偷得意
data.description: 【海滨商业街·午后】圭穿着蓝灰色泳装外搭轻薄风衣，蹲在自动贩卖机前认真比较两种冷饮；她最终选择最划算的一瓶，坐到海堤边把罐子贴在脸上，蓝眼睛里藏着小小的得意。
data.lighting: warm afternoon light with cool can highlights
data.promptProse: Kei Shirogane from Kaguya-sama: Love Is War wears a slate-blue swimsuit with a light windbreaker, black headband and a chilled canned drink. She crouches before a seaside vending machine and compares two chilled drinks with practical concentration. She chooses the better value, then sits on the seawall with the cold can against her cheek, letting a small victorious smile escape into the afternoon. warm afternoon light with cool can highlights.
data.title: 白银圭 · 海边自动贩卖机的冷饮选择
